column1: # cGAS structures for cgas-oligo-sim. Fill cif_path, then run:
#   python3 bin/prepare_structures.py --samplesheet structures.tsv \
#       --reference <human_cGAS_Q8N884.fasta> --out-dir work/struct
# PROVENANCE. Every field below was checked against PDB entry records in this
# session except where marked UNVERIFIED. Nothing here is from memory.
#   4MKP  "Crystal structure of human cGAS apo form", 1.95 A, Homo sapiens,
#         Mutation(s): 0, 364 residues, gene MB21D1.
#   6CT9  "Structure of the human cGAS-DNA complex", 2.26 A, Homo sapiens,
#         UniProt Q8N884, chain A = protein (367 aa), chains B/C = 17-mer DNA,
#         plus Zn. Sequence modifications: Ser156 expression tag,
#         Asn187 (WT Lys187) and Arg195 (WT Leu195), both ENGINEERED MUTATIONS.
#   6CTA  "Structure of the human cGAS-DNA complex with ATP", 2.78 A,
#         Homo sapiens, Mutation(s): 2, mutagens K187N, L195R. Same construct
#         as 6CT9 with ATP bound.
#   4O69  "Human cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS) in complex with sulfate ion",
#         2.25 A, Homo sapiens, Mutation(s): 0, 363 residues.
# NOT INCLUDED, and why:
#   4O6A  "Mouse cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS) in complex with DNA",
#         Mus musculus, 1.86 A. This is MOUSE. This project is human-scoped,
#         and human and mouse cGAS differ at exactly the positions that control
#         DNA-length sensitivity (187/195), so mixing them would confound the
#         comparison you are making. Added below as an explicit, labelled
#         cross-species control only - leave it commented out unless you want it.
# K187/L195: human WT is K187/L195; the mouse-equivalent residues are N187/R195.
# 6CT9 and 6CTA were crystallised carrying the mouse-like N187/R195, which sit
# in the DNA-binding region under study. 'auto' reverts them to the reference
# and records every change in work/struct/wt_reversions.tsv.
# chain: comma-separated, or 'all' for every protein chain that survives
#   stripping. assembly: blank = deposited coordinates; otherwise the assembly
#   id to expand first (check _pdbx_struct_assembly in the mmCIF - the id is
#   usually '1', but confirm rather than assume).
# Non-protein chains are ALWAYS dropped, so 6CT9's crystallographic 17-mer
# (chains B/C) and its Zn do not reach the CG build.
structure_id
cgas_apo_human
cgas_dna_monomer
cgas_dna_dimer
#cgas_dna_atp_human
#cgas_sulfate_human
# UNVERIFIED: 4K8V's entry title is the generic "Structure of cyclic GMP-AMP
# Synthase (cGAS)" (2.00 A, Gao/Wu/Patel, deposited 2013-04-18). The records I
# could reach did NOT state its source organism or confirm it is apo, so it is
# left commented out. Confirm both before using it:
#   curl -s https://data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/entry/4K8V | python3 -m json.tool
#cgas_apo_4k8v
# Cross-species control only. Never pool with the human arms.
#cgas_dna_mouse
